answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 146315 Country: India Title: Does any wrongdoings of working partner affects the capital partner? Question: I am interested to invest in private businesses as a capital partner. And if the working partner does wrong things like bribing, not giving correct quality, cheating customers, etc. Is it sinful on my part to invest in that business because of his wrong deeds? Answer ID: 146315 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 161/150/SN=3/1438) It is totally unlawful and haram to accept bribe. Likewise, cheating people and not providing original quality to them is also unlawful. And after knowing that so and so person adopts such unlawful ways in the business yet starting business with him in partnership is helping in unlawful task which is not lawful as per the Shari’ah. Hence you must not invest with such a person in the business; otherwise you shall also be involved in sin with him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
